title: Blue Boy Planet
description: An emotional cinematic orchestral composition about imagination, wonder, childhood innocence and the idea that love never truly disappears.

sections.title: The Story
sections.body: Blue Boy Planet is inspired by the story of a 6-year-old boy whose journey continues far beyond our world. Through music and visuals, this short film reimagines loss as a cosmic voyage: a young boy decides to leave Earth behind to explore distant planets, galaxies and the mysteries of the universe.
